usedFor: Microsoft Dynamics CRM holds leads and Conversion Chats sends template messages, so “New Lead” can feed “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new lead gets a first template message while the enquiry is still fresh.

watchOut: “New Lead” in Microsoft Dynamics CRM is polling, and a message to a lead waits for your approval.
